original.target_description: Published Experiment 2: between-participant relationship of the rate of accepting personally rated unfair offers with right VLPFC activation for accepted versus rejected offers, MNI [50,24,8]; Figure 4d and associated whole-brain regression result.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants in the Experiment 2 group fMRI regression; twelve participants are explicitly reported in Methods, with each participant entering the group regression. The target statistic reports t(11).
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for the target analysis. Number of accepted/rejected trials entering each participant contrast is not specified.
n.location: Article p. 342 (PDF p. 4), Experiment 2, Participants and Task; fMRI Acquisition and Analysis, final paragraph. Target result p. 344 (PDF p. 6).
n.quote: Twelve undergraduates (average age 5 21.8 years; 9 females, 3 ... males) participated.

es.location: Article p. 344 (PDF p. 6), fMRI Results: Accepting Unfair Offers, final paragraph, right column; Figure 4d.

p.location: Article p. 344 (PDF p. 6), fMRI Results: Accepting Unfair Offers, final paragraph, right VLPFC result.

notes: Original-only blind validation. Published article version supplied in the assigned input; PDF pages 4 and 6 were rendered and visually inspected. Printed d = 2.22 and t(11) = 3.68 belong to the target between-participant association, rather than the different accepted-unfair-versus-resting-baseline contrast (whose result spans pp. 343–344). Figure 4d additionally prints r = .76; the requested printed d is retained without conversion. The target reports p_rep > .99, not a conventional null-hypothesis p-value: p.value and p.bound remain null, with no conversion. Canonical text renders mathematical equals signs as the glyph 5 and the subscripted p_rep as prep; quotations preserve these exact canonical glyphs. Explicit ellipses omit interleaved opposite-column text and associated layout whitespace. Rendered pages confirm the numerical meanings. The sample is supported by the explicit Experiment 2 participant count and the stated participant-by-participant group regression, rather than by deriving n from the target degrees of freedom. Unassigned replication and reported_success are required null placeholders.
